about: All 55 trophies are earned offline in single-player; there are no online trophies (KeenGamer). 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase. Guides are original text written for this entry; facts beyond the official descriptions cite the sources named on each trophy. Seven trophies are flagged missable (a one-attempt condition, retryable) and seven are flagged unconfirmed (no cited guide has confirmed a method yet).

roadmap.title: Play the story — Chapters 1–4 and the finale
roadmap.text: Just enjoy the campaign. The 12 story trophies (the opening mission, Chapters 1–4, the final mission and the six named missions) all pop as you play, and nothing in the story is permanently missable. Push Square's advice is the same: start by playing the story at leisure. Do side activities you pass, but save the grind for after the credits.

roadmap.title: Side strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and strangers
roadmap.text: After the story, or between chapters, finish the five named side strands and 8 stranger strands. These are the silver 'Strangers & Freaks' plus five bronzes. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so sweep the map for them.

roadmap.title: Activities — ranges, races, drones, fishing, arcade, bowling
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges, win 20 different races and drone races at all 14 locations, beat Cal's fishing challenge, finish an arcade game and bowl at Kolt & Associates. Try each of the 9 activity types for 'Master of None' along the way. The shooting range is the longest grind here — do a few challenges per visit.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration — cards, WAiNK, meditations, vehicles
roadmap.text: Complete 3 card sets (15 for 100%), scan 100 WAiNK locations, meditate at all 18 spots — GameMapa flags one meditation as missable, so do them as you find them — discover 100 vehicles and explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Scan and collect everything you pass during the other stages and this stage shrinks.

roadmap.title: Money and mayhem — vaults, trucks, shops and garages
roadmap.text: Rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck and a jewelry store undetected; rob one illegal operation per gang; launder $250,000 in marked bills; spend $100,000 in shops; buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles with Scooter Bros. The garage spending counts toward the $100,000 too. Read the missable flags before the one-attempt jobs (jewelry store, armored truck, partner robberies).

roadmap.title: Cleanup and 100% — stunts, challenges, choices and the platinum
roadmap.text: Finish 250 stunts, 50 challenges (70 for 100%), and let the 500 Criminal Profile choices accumulate. Then open the 100% checklist (Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion) and clear what is left. 'A Long Road' pops at 100% — and the platinum, 'Vice Got a Price!', follows with it. Push Square estimates the full platinum at 300 hours or more.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks, so there is no separate task to plan for it. Work the roadmap in order — story, side strands, activities, collectibles, then the 100% checklist — and treat 'A Long Road' (100% completion) as the real final gate, since it is the trophy most players earn last. Push Square puts the full platinum at 300 hours or more, so pace it rather than rushing the checklist.
steps: Finish the story and the final mission.
Complete every side strand (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and 8 stranger strands).
Clear the activities: shooting range golds, races, drone races, fishing, arcade and bowling.
Finish the collectibles: cards, WAiNK scans, meditations, vehicles and exploration.
Reach 100% completion ('A Long Road') — the platinum follows.

Push Square lists it as unlocked as part of the story, and it is one of the 28 hidden trophies on PlayStation, so it stays hidden in your console list until it pops.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening.
Follow the mission prompts through 'Gone Fishing' to its conclusion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. The 100% checklist unlocks only after the story (Push Square: Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion), and — despite the name — you do not have to do literally everything: Push Square lists 15 of the 18 collectible card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges as the 100% requirements, for example. Check the list after the finale, work the biggest remaining blocks first (cards, challenges, stunts), and let the checklist itself be your cleanup order.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the 100% checklist.
Open Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion and read what is left.
Clear the big blocks: 15 card sets, 70 challenges, and the activity totals.
Mop up the remaining checklist items, then this gold pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in Leonida (Push Square), so you need a little over half of them: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Stunt jumps are the easiest to rack up while driving — ramps, bridges and construction sites — while the flying ones need an aircraft and a steady hand. Track them at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map at Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots. Note that extra challenges attached to stunt jumps are not needed for this trophy.
steps: Open Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see nearby stunt locations.
Clear stunt jumps while driving — ramps and bridges count.
Use an aircraft for under-the-bridge and knife flights.
Try base jumps from Leonida's tallest peaks and buildings.
Check Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts until you reach 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types to sample (GameMapa lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt). You only have to try each one once — no wins or scores needed — so the cheapest path is to touch each activity the first time you pass it rather than saving them all for a cleanup session.
steps: Try fishing once.
Try hunting and golf once each.
Visit a shooting range, play pool and basketball once each.
Play one arcade/video game, enter one race and complete one stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The grindy silver: gold medals in all 42 shooting range challenges (Push Square). There are two ranges — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — and most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold. Some challenges are locked until you meet other conditions, which the map shows. Find ranges at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges and track progress there. Do a few each visit instead of leaving all 42 to the end.
steps: Find a range: Rodgers Ranch (Port Gellhorn) or Griffin (Balsero).
Work through the challenges, golding each tier — most have three.
Check the map for locked challenges and their unlock conditions.
Track golds at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges until all 42 are gold.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (Push Square). Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find them at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones, and treat each location as its own race to win — winning the same location twice does not help.
steps: Open Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones for the locations.
Race at each of the 14 locations (some need an entry fee).
Win each location once.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the same race won twice only counts once (Push Square). Race locations appear all over Leonida as you explore, and most let you hire a car; if you use your own, watch its Rating, which you can raise with upgrades from mod shops. Track them at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing and pick off the easy ones first.
steps: Find race locations while exploring; track them at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
Win a race — hire a car or use your own with a good Rating.
Repeat at 19 more, different locations.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Fairly early in the game Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2kg (Push Square). Fish in the area marked on your map until you land one big enough — you need a boat with a fishing rod, but there are plenty of boats in the area to borrow if you do not own one. Losing the challenge costs nothing but time: you can try again.
steps: Take Cal's request when it arrives.
Get a boat with a fishing rod to the marked fishing area.
Fish until you catch a parrotfish over 2kg and beat Cal's challenge.

steps: Collect cards while exploring Leonida.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open the phone; WAiNK is on Jason's or Lucia's smartphone). Push Square breaks the scannable spots down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — more than 100 in total, so you can skip the awkward ones. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations, and scan everything you pass while doing other trophies.
steps: Open WAiNK from the phone (hold Up).
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you pass them.
Check Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations until you reach 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (Push Square). Challenges are the game's own in-game achievements — skill feats tracked at Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges — and 70 of them are needed for 100% completion, so this bronze is a milestone on the way to 'A Long Road', not a separate grind. Read the challenge list early and let the easy ones happen naturally.
steps: Open Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges to see the list.
Complete the easiest challenges first as you play.
Keep going to 50 — 70 are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: One-attempt condition: the escape must succeed with your partner beside you — if you are busted or your partner goes down, set it up and try again.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape with your partner still beside you. The hard part is keeping your partner alive and with you through the escape — break line of sight, get distance, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
steps: Have your partner with you.
Raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and escape until the wanted level clears, with your partner.

trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between — the chain is the trophy, not the individual robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, keep the wanted level alive between them, and do not get busted or lose the cops until the third robbery is done.
steps: Have your partner with you and pick three nearby shops.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level.
Rob the second, then the third, back-to-back without losing the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties for $160,000 in total (Push Square): Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Buy the 8 garages — $160,000 in total.
